title: Behavioural Signs
learning_goal: Identify behavioural red flags linked to DFV exposure.

content.micro_lesson: Common signs include aggression, withdrawal, perfectionism, clinginess, school refusal, and unexplained physical symptoms. Behaviour is communication.
content.activity: Complete a behaviour-tracking exercise using the provided template.
content.escalation_trigger: Child expressing fear of going home triggers immediate safety check.
